an7.645-1124:2.3: niṭṭhitaṃ → rāgapadato paṭṭhāya pamādapadapariyattesu sattarassu padesu ekamekaṃ abhiññāyādidasapadehi yojetvā satta dhammā bhāvetabbā’ti niddiṭṭhehi tīhi sattabojjhaṅga (satta aniccasaññādi - satta asubhasaññādi suttehi paccekaṃ ghaṭitāni sabbasuttati dasādhika pañcasatāni honti.)
